import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    static int n;
    static long[][] matrix_p;
    static long[][] matrix_pro;
    static int[] bit_count;
    static long[][] q_array;
    static List<List<Integer>> groups;
    static int[] id_array;
    static Map<Pair, Integer> memo;

    static class Pair {
        int current;
        long state;

        Pair(int current, long state) {
            this.current = current;
            this.state = state;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object o) {
            if (this == o) return true;
            if (!(o instanceof Pair)) return false;
            Pair pair = (Pair) o;
            return current == pair.current && state == pair.state;
        }

        @Override
        public int hashCode() {
            return Objects.hash(current, state);
        }
    }

    static long power(long base, long exp, long modulus) {
        long result = 1;
        base %= modulus;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) result = (result * base) % modulus;
            base = (base * base) % modulus;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }

    static long compute(int current, long state) {
        if (state == 0) return 0;
        if (current == n) return 1;
        Pair key = new Pair(current, state);
        if (memo.containsKey(key)) return memo.get(key);
        long answer = 0;
        int limit = 1 << n;
        for (int subset = 1; subset < limit; subset++) {
            long new_state = 0;
            for (int k = 0; k < groups.get(current).size(); k++) {
                if ((state & (1L << k)) == 0) continue;
                int cur = groups.get(current).get(k);
                int nxt = subset - (subset & cur);
                new_state |= q_array[cur][nxt];
            }
            long temp = (matrix_pro[current][subset] * compute(current + 1, new_state)) % MOD;
            answer = (answer + temp) % MOD;
        }
        memo.put(key, answer);
        return answer;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        n = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
        matrix_p = new long[n][n];
        matrix_pro = new long[n][1 << n];
        bit_count = new int[1 << n];
        q_array = new long[n][1 << n];
        groups = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            groups.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }
        id_array = new int[1 << n];
        memo = new HashMap<>();

        int inv_100 = (int) power(100, MOD - 2, MOD);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String[] parts = br.readLine().split(" ");
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                int val = Integer.parseInt(parts[j]);
                matrix_p[i][j] = (long) val * inv_100 % MOD;
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < (1 << n); j++) {
                matrix_pro[i][j] = 1;
                for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) {
                    if (((j >> k) & 1) == 1) {
                        matrix_pro[i][j] = (matrix_pro[i][j] * matrix_p[i][k]) % MOD;
                    } else {
                        matrix_pro[i][j] = (matrix_pro[i][j] * (MOD + 1 - matrix_p[i][k]) % MOD) % MOD;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << n); i++) {
            bit_count[i] = Integer.bitCount(i);
            groups.get(bit_count[i]).add(i);
            id_array[i] = groups.get(bit_count[i]).size() - 1;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << n); i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (((i >> j) & 1) == 0) {
                    q_array[i][1 << j] = 1L << id_array[i | (1 << j)];
                }
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < (1 << n); j++) {
                q_array[i][j] = q_array[i][(j & -j)] | q_array[i][j ^ (j & -j)];
            }
        }

        System.out.println(compute(0, 1));
    }
}
